biography.plain_text: Enzo Potolicchio is a Venezuelan businessman and endurance racing driver who won the LMP2 class at Le Mans in 2012. He founded 8Star Motorsports and has operated electronics repair franchises in the United States. His family’s commercial interests also included construction in Venezuela, where he worked on building sites between races.

long_biography.plain_text:
Businessman and racing team owner Enzo Potolicchio helped Sean Rayhall move from sports cars into Indy Lights in 2015. They assembled sponsorship for a partial season, and Potolicchio supported Rayhall’s attempt to supplement it through crowdfunding. Rayhall won at Indianapolis and Mid-Ohio.

During the pandemic, Potolicchio’s repair franchise business responded to falling shop traffic by sending technicians to customers’ homes. The service covered phones, laptops and other electronic devices, including older computers brought back into use for home working. Home appointments helped build customer loyalty and repeat business, and encouraged subsequent visits to his stores.
